description: This circular walk takes you from Totnes to the neighbouring village of Ashprington. Starting on the river in Totnes you'll head south along the Dart Valley Trail to Ashprington, passing the Sharpham Estate on the way. In the pretty village there a noteworthy church dating from the 15th century and a local pub for refreshments. The route then takes you north along quiet country lanes to return to Totnes. On the walk there are some splendid views across the lovely Dart Valley countryside and hills.
